incidents.details: First execution ended with exit code 1 after 184/200 valid codebooks; no message trial had yet been written. A later continuation reused those files.

Before the G-G2 orange guard became visible, a continuation completed codebook generation and wrote 14 partial message attempts (11 for adversarial_repeated; one each for natural_text, printable_ascii, and uniform_bytes). These partial outputs are excluded from efficacy estimates. A subsequent invocation was refused by the runner guard. No further C_geo or F_geo evaluation is authorized under the current stop gate.
The updated G-G2 gate refuses any C_geo rerun after pixels_opened=true. The attempted invocation exited before image access or new output. C_geo partial outputs remain excluded; F_geo remains sealed.
